host_target_rule: Compiler host builds do not establish execution of emitted code on that host.

checks.contract: Install a native compiler artifact into a clean test environment and compile/run independently supplied programs without Python, a hidden seed execution service, or cached answers. Record allowed OS/runtime dependencies.

Familiar variables, ordinary numeric/string/boolean values, functions, calls, scopes, conditions/loops, lists and user classes work natively with meaningful diagnostics. Do not require every hosted integer literal to be written as i64(...). Preserve inherited richer semantic obligations for HATCH.
Indented suites, depth markers, brace suites with no required indentation and standalone named sections execute; maps/sets/strings/regexes and mixed nesting are not corrupted.
Token-aware project aliases, imports and source maps work; invalid/ambiguous source is rejected and reported at the original location.
Typed literals and developer-defined scale/affine relations lower to general native operations; Gramme/Kilo and temperature point/delta tests pass with incompatible cases rejected.
Numeric constraints, checked runtime construction, custom regex captures/properties, and native Email/IP-style structured values have actual valid/invalid-input tests.
Partial-class directory/file enforcement and scoped extensions work without layout mutation, cross-package reopening or accidental name merging.
Collection/array reductions and basic shape-aware numeric operations execute; sum(1,2,4778,6), list .sum() and constrained constant conversion behave as documented.
Native threads and async tasks execute with defined lifecycle/cleanup, and a custom typed event has real subscription/disposal behavior. Do not mistake async scheduling for multicore execution.
CLI build/check/run/test/help, deterministic local module resolution and a basic installable VSIX with real shared-frontend diagnostics, build and run work on the reference target.

At least one native persistent-cell workflow works through the real compiler, and standalone release execution does not depend on session state. Remaining full interaction/debug/platform obligations stay open.
Reproducible artifact/checksums, limitations, tests, source hash, recovery checkpoint and a read-only progress summary exist. All inherited unfulfilled HATCH gates remain visibly open.
